title: Study of Ovarian Reserve Concerning Patients With Multiple Sclerosis (MS), Compared to a Control Group
official: Study of Ovarian Reserve Concerning Patients With Multiple Sclerosis, Compared to a Control Group
summary: The investigators want to evaluate ovarian reserve concerning patients with multiple sclerosis, compared to a control group of healthy women. This study will include women from 25 to 35 years old.
